subject: CloudNova co-sell certification prerequisites & sprint ask
messages:
From: Partners CloudNova <partners@cloudnova.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity: Redwood + CloudNova marketplace co-sell / cert questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the intro (talked to Marissa earlier this week) — CloudNova is ready to start the cloud marketplace listing process and we want to make sure co-sell certification (AWS + Azure) goes smoothly. We pulled together a short spreadsheet of questions on legal/contracting, listing assets, pricing commitments and evidence for technical integration (attached).

High-level asks from our side:
- What are the minimum ops/observability artifacts Redwood needs for co-sell (traces, model telemetry, SLA language)?
- Any recommended artifacts or templates for the marketplace listing (media, architecture diagram, usage samples)?
- For AWS co-sell, does Redwood handle the partner registration step or do we need to submit separately?
- Timeline estimate for Redwood to review and sign off on the listing assets (we're aiming for a May marketplace publish).

Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week (Tue/Wed) to align on owners and a short sprint to prepare artifacts?

Attaching: cloudnova-marketplace-questions.xlsx

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships, CloudNova
partners@cloudnova.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Partners CloudNova <partners@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity: Redwood + CloudNova marketplace co-sell / cert questions

Alex — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. I reviewed the spreadsheet quickly; good structure. Quick answers up front and then proposed next steps below.

Short answers:
- Minimum ops artifacts: onboarding guide (runbook), token-level cost map, latency/availability SLOs, and a minimal tracing example that demonstrates request->model flow. We typically ask partners for a short section describing privacy/data flow.
- Listing assets: marketing one-pager, architecture diagram (SVG/PDF), two short videos (60–90s), and a sample integration tutorial. We can share Redwood templates for the architecture diagram and video script.
- AWS registration: CloudNova should initiate the AWS partner registration. Redwood will provide a co-sell readiness letter and technical evidence after we validate the integration.
- Timeline: If we start next week, a 2-week rapid prep sprint is feasible for a first pass (review + one revision). Final marketplace publish will depend on partner portal queues.

Proposed next steps (owners):
1) Kickoff meeting (30m) — owners: Vivek (Redwood partner lead) + Alex (CloudNova) — schedule Tue 4/20 or Wed 4/21.
2) Redwood artifact templates shared (vanessa) — due 4/22.
3) Partner fills asset checklist (cloudnova) — due 4/27.
4) Technical evidence review (jordan + marissa) — 4/28–4/30.

I attached our co-sell readiness checklist to accelerate. Vanessa, can you add the templates to the shared drive and drop the link? Karthik/Marissa — I looped you for pricing/commitment and tech review respectively.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-co-sell-readiness-checklist.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: Redwood + CloudNova marketplace co-sell / cert questions

Thanks Vivek — added a quick pricing note.

Notes for the team (internal):
- CloudNova wants to be priced in the typical marketplace SKU model; they asked whether Redwood can support both consumption (per-token) and committed monthly usage for Dedicated customers. We should confirm whether marketplace listing needs a single SKU (consumption) or multiple SKUs for committed plans.
- I'll reach out to finance to confirm how discounts are surfaced in the AWS listing & co-sell signage.
- Action items:
  * Vanessa: upload templates + sample architecture diagram to Drive by 4/22. Put a README for security/compliance artifacts (SOC2 evidence pointers).
  * Marissa: block 4/28–4/30 for an integration review call with CloudNova engineers. Bring the onboarding runbook checklist.
  * Jordan: prepare a short note on required telemetry hooks (KV cache visibility, request id propagation) — due 4/26.

Vivek / team — thanks for the quick responses and the checklist.

We're aligned on the timeline and can commit to the sprint items. Two quick asks before the kickoff:
1) Can you share the co-sell readiness template as a PDF so our procurement team can pre-check contract terms?
2) Could Redwood provide a short statement on data residency and encryption in transit/at rest for the listing? Our compliance team wants a sentence we can include in the marketplace submission.

We'll confirm the kickoff time tomorrow once you share availability. Looking forward to working with Redwood — happy to be flexible on the timeline if it helps with documentation windows.

Best,
Jorge Martinez
CTO, CloudNova Inc.
cto@cloudnova.com
